name: uxkin
title: UXKIN
description: Search real iPhone app screens, user journeys and website design systems, and bring real UI references into Raycast AI.
author: uxkin

commands.name: search-ui-references
commands.title: Search UI References
commands.subtitle: UXKIN
commands.description: Search real app screens, user journeys and websites, for example paywall, onboarding or delete account.

commands.name: search-design-systems
commands.title: Search Design Systems
commands.subtitle: UXKIN
commands.description: Search design systems taken from real websites: colors with their roles, fonts, components and a DESIGN.md.

commands.name: my-collections
commands.title: My Collections
commands.subtitle: UXKIN
commands.description: Browse the screens, apps and websites you saved on UXKIN.

tools.name: find-ui-references
tools.title: Find UI References
tools.description: Search UXKIN's library of real iOS app screens, user journeys (ordered multi-screen flows such as onboarding, subscribing or deleting an account) and websites. Works best with short queries: a flow or screen type, an app category or an app name. Search a few times with different words rather than one long sentence.

tools.name: get-journey
tools.title: Get Journey
tools.description: Get every screen of one user journey from find-ui-references, in order, with each step's image and link. Use it to compare flows end to end.

tools.name: find-ui-materials
tools.title: Find Design Systems
tools.description: Search design systems taken from real websites: colors with their roles, typography and components for each result, and the complete DESIGN.md for the top result. Query by industry, theme, brand color, style, font or site name.

tools.name: list-collections
tools.title: List Collections
tools.description: List the collections the person saved on UXKIN, with how many items each holds.

tools.name: get-collection
tools.title: Get Collection
tools.description: Get the saved screens, apps and websites in one of the person's UXKIN collections, by name or id.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
